# FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter`

Manual: [FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter.md)

```text
FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereBosonsFermionsConverter [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : name of the file that contains the bosonic(fermionic) state that will be multiplied (divided) by a Jastrow Factor (multiple arguments)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --p-truncated : use a p-truncated basis instead of the full n-body basis
    --p-truncation : p-truncation for the p-truncated basis (if --p-truncated is used) (default value = 0)
    --boson-truncation : maximum occupation for a given orbital for the p-truncated basis (default value = 1)
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state (should be the one of the bosonic state)
    --vector-file : single column file describing a list of state belonging to the same hilbert space to be converted

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

output options:
    -o, --output-states : output file name (if none, guess it from the input file name) (multiple arguments)

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
